# The `value` Struct Template Reference

<DoxygenPage version="1.13.2">

A generic value used to define floating points, which, in addition to the actual value, has an epsilon, to use the desired precision during comparisons. If missing, the default is 1 / (10^decimals). <Link to="#details">More...</Link>
